skills.name: korecomms
skills.purpose: Publish a complete HTML email through an existing KoreComms delivery binding.
skills.selection_description: Use to send a finished HTML email through the current chat's configured delivery binding.

tools.name: delivery_publish_html
tools.purpose: Publish one complete HTML email. Use only after composing the finished body; never send a status message, file path, code, or draft.

chat_name.description: The delivery-bound chat name returned by the earlier delivery-bind command.

html_body.description: The complete email-safe HTML body. It may use any reasonable readable HTML structure, such as headings, paragraphs, lists, tables, or sections.

tools.returns: The delivery confirmation, including the sent message identifier.
